content.text: For digital creators in Nigeria, the reality of payment processing is a daily frustration. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted, leaving you with limited options for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-what-nobody-tells|Selling PDF]]-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-what-actually-how|selling]] your digital products. The conventional solutions, like Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Paddle, offer workarounds, but they're not built for your context. They're temporary patches, not permanent fixes. This is where COREMERCH comes in—a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that provides a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-github-pages-free-digital-product|COREMERCH guide to complete]] alternative, giving you full control and ownership of your online store.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Lemon squeezy

COREMERCH is not just another platform; it's a base-layer infrastructure solution. We design, document, and deploy sovereign digital commerce stacks—combinations of free and paid tools that enable you to create a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and complete data ownership. This is not a quick fix; it's a long-term structural change. We're talking about moving from rented infrastructure to owned infrastructure, from dependence to independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built on a stack of powerful, free tools. We use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly, and NOWPayments verifies crypto payments automatically with a tiny 0.5% fee. This architecture is designed for low-fee transactions on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, ensuring you and your customers aren't burdened with high costs. The beauty is in the simplicity and the freedom it provides.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is specifically built for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines—places where conventional payment platforms have drawn a line. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products but are often left out of the global digital economy. We're here to change that. COREMERCH provides an on-ramp to the digital economy, not a detour.
COREMERCH gives you full ownership and control, not a platform to rent.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH infrastructure is a carefully curated collection of best-in-class tools. Each component is free, open, and powerful in its own right. When combined, they form a robust, flexible, and secure digital commerce platform. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide fast, reliable hosting. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script add backend logic without server management. Supabase and Google Sheets offer scalable order storage. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 ensure fast, secure file delivery. NOWPayments brings it all together with automatic crypto payment verification. This is a stack built to last, not a collection of hacks.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying a COREMERCH stack is straightforward and accessible. Our products, like the Edge Commerce Stack, are designed to get you up and running quickly. For $197, you get Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, complete with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. We load five of your products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability, and end-to-end test the system. You also get 30 days of support to ensure a smooth start. After that, you own it all. No subscriptions, no platform dependence, just your digital commerce infrastructure, ready for business.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

COREMERCH offers a permanent solution to the payment processing challenges faced by digital creators in Nigeria and other restricted countries. By providing a complete sovereign commerce infrastructure, we enable you to sell your digital products directly, accepting crypto payments from anywhere in the world with low fees and no intermediaries. This is not a temporary workaround but a base-layer solution, giving you the freedom and control to thrive in the global digital economy.
Our infrastructure is pressure-tested in environments where conventional platforms fail.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack is a perfect example of COREMERCH's commitment to providing sovereign commerce infrastructure. For $197, you get a fully configured stack, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration, ready to sell your digital products globally. This is infrastructure built for the long haul, not a temporary fix.
Your Deployment Checklist

Here's a step-by-step guide to deploying your COREMERCH stack:
1. Choose your stack: Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or go straight to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for more advanced features.
2. Provide product details: Share the digital products you want to sell, and we'll load them into your store.
3. Deploy and configure: We'll deploy your chosen stack within 48 hours, complete with hosting, backend logic, order storage, and crypto payment processing.
4. Test and launch: We'll end-to-end test the system and provide 30 days of support to ensure a smooth launch.
5. Own and operate: After deployment, you own it all. No subscriptions, no platform fees, just your digital commerce infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why can't I just use a conventional platform like Stripe or PayPal?

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable or severely restricted in certain countries due to regulatory and compliance issues. They are built for specific markets and may not cater to the unique needs of digital creators in these regions. Using them requires workarounds that are temporary and may not provide the level of control and ownership that COREMERCH offers.
What makes COREMERCH different from other e-commerce platforms?

COREMERCH is not just another e-commerce platform. It's a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that provides you with the tools and knowledge to own and operate your online store. We don't lock you into a platform or charge recurring fees. You get lifetime access to the infrastructure, and we have no access to your store after deployment, ensuring complete data ownership and control.
How does the crypto payment processing work, and is it secure?

COREMERCH uses NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a low 0.5% fee with no KYC requirements. When a customer pays in crypto, NOWPayments automatically fires a webhook upon on-chain confirmation, ensuring secure and instant payment verification. This process is designed for low-fee transactions, making it affordable and accessible.
What kind of support does COREMERCH provide during and after deployment?

With the Edge Commerce Stack, you get 30 days of support to ensure a smooth start. This includes assistance with setting up your products, configuring email deliverability, and end-to-end testing. After the initial support period, you own the infrastructure, and we have no further access. However, we provide extensive documentation and guides to help you manage and scale your store.
How can I trust COREMERCH with my digital commerce needs?

COREMERCH is built on a foundation of trust and sovereignty. Our infrastructure is designed to give you full control and ownership, ensuring you're not dependent on any platform. We've pressure-tested our solution in environments with actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation, ensuring it's robust and reliable. Your success is our success, and we're committed to helping you thrive in the global digital economy.
No more workarounds; it's time for a permanent, sovereign solution.
